csv_scope_of_work: The City of Topeka ("City") is soliciting competitive proposals through this Request for Proposals (RFP) for a Design-Build contract to provide professional engineering and construction services for the Concrete Pavement Rehabilitation/Resurfacing 6th & Fairlawn / Cypress Sycamore Rice Project (Project Nos. 841211.02 and 841211.07). The City of Topeka seeks a Design-Build team to provide engineering, design, construction, inspection, and construction administration services for pavement rehabilitation and resurfacing of multiple roadway corridors, including joint repairs, asphalt overlays, curb and gutter repairs, ADA ramp improvements, traffic control, and related roadway improvements
